{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dup_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {patient_dup_count}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check if there are both female and male patients in the treatment arm
arm_sex_counts = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['sex'].value_counts()
print(f'Gender distribution in treatment arm: {arm_sex_counts.to_dict()}')

# Check if there are any patients with sample_seq > 1 (retested)
retested_count = (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f'Number of retested patients (sample_seq > 1): {retested_count}')"}
